run_preprocess_questions_cli: run the preprocess_questions CLI to tokenize questions and write train val test HDF5 files from an input JSON
buildVocab: build a token to index vocabulary from a list of text sequences with optional special tokens and minimum count filtering
tokenize: tokenize a string sequence by splitting on a delimiter and optionally adding start and end tokens
encode: encode a list of string tokens into integer indices using a token to index vocabulary mapping
decode: decode a list of integer indices back into string tokens using an index to token mapping
